bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
actual="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
tagged="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)"
compose_file="$(docker inspect --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files" }}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
project="$(docker inspect --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project" }}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
printf 'PR47_DEPLOY_IMAGE_BASELINE\nRUNNING_IMAGE=%s\nTAG_IMAGE=%s\nPROJECT=%s\nCOMPOSE_FILES=%s\n' "$actual" "$tagged" "$project" "$compose_file" | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
